For $n>0$, let the original input $x$ be bounded by $U$, and let its parameter header and six color fields be stored before the free pointer. Under the exact normalization space, word, and depth bounds, procedure 45 constructs the selected-color normalized output, returns the layout-defined normalized end, and preserves memory below the free pointer within its stated time.
